regions.merged_text: We hope this find you improved and improving. However, we must be ready to face facts. Please pardon brevity, but your letter - rather your description of your trouble sounds like trouble which sooner Every sister - if she live long enough should expect. So in case those dizy spells continue do not be upset about but have a little patience and offer all for the intentions of the Sacred Heart.
